Hi Sanjay / Alyssa —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As discussed, we want to finalize a short mutual action plan (MAP) and lock the executive board (EB) review slot so your procurement and legal teams can finish the SOW review on track. To keep momentum, proposed next steps: 

- Internal sponsor mapping: we suggest a two-tier exec sponsor model (Business Sponsor + Technical Sponsor) to streamline approvals. I sketched assignments in the attached MAP_v1 and included proposed owners for each action item.
- EB meeting window: target week of Sep 6th for a 45-minute EB review (goal: alignment + signoff checklist).
- Dependencies: procurement specs, security attestation summary (SOC2 in progress), and final pricing table.

Please confirm: (1) names for Business and Technical sponsors on your side, (2) whether the Sep 6–10 window works, and (3) any additional reviewers who must attend.

I've attached the MAP draft and a placeholder SOW to help structure the EB packet. If OK, Marissa will take the lead on the EB agenda and materials.

Thanks — I know timelines are tight.

—Dylan

Thanks Dylan — good framing. A couple of operational notes from my side: 

- EB packet: we'll keep it to three artifacts: 1) one-page value memo, 2) MAP with clear owners & due dates, 3) SOW + pricing appendix. I can own the packet and draft the slides if Sanjay/Alyssa share sponsor names this week.
- Proposed Redwood exec attendees: Karthik (Solutions Exec) + Olga (Security & Compliance lead) — both can present and answer questions.
- On timing: Sep 7th (Tuesday) 10:00–10:45 PT or Sep 9th (Thursday) 14:00–14:45 PT are my preferred slots. If we get a hard constraint from Continuum, we'll adjust.

Action items I’ll do after sponsor confirmation:
- Create EB invite (ics) and share read-ahead on Drive
- Lock slide owners and rehearsal slot the day before the EB meeting

Marissa
